events.title: Development Newsletter: Steam Next Fest & Hermit Demo
events.summary: Hello, all!I'm back after a long break during the months of August/September with some more game updates! While a number of major changes were shipped for the demo during August and September, there were no newsletters posted while I've been away. As a result, some important updates from all three months are included here.Steam Next Fest, Demo Finalization, and the main gameOver the past year I have worked somewhat tirelessly on updating the Hermit Demo. This has been helpful for me as a develop

events.title: Demo Patch Notes for 2026-10-12
events.summary: Shipped new 2D and 3D art assets for the Nemin Wanders / Nemin caravan

events.title: Demo Patch Notes for 2026-10-10

events.title: Demo Patch Notes for 2026-10-09
events.summary: Fixed an issue that could sometimes cause food to persist forever in inventory when dropped, picked up, and immediately consumed

events.title: Demo Patch Notes for 2026-10-06
events.summary: Added a new HUD element for tracking the currently active questThe new quest-tracker HUD UI can also be disabled from the game settings menu for players that prefer the HUD look without it

events.title: Demo Patch Notes for 2026-10-04
events.summary: Fixed an issue with dungeon bear traps not persisting

events.title: Demo Patch Notes for 2026-09-22b
events.summary: Fixed an issue with worm enemies despawning randomly

events.title: Demo Patch Notes for 2026-09-22
events.summary: Pushed some small Halloween event changes to the demo beta installsHalloween changes, once completed, will be pushed to all players on October 1st

events.title: Demo Patch Notes for 2026-09-15
events.summary: Disabled some of the new landscape grass meshes temporarily for performance debugging

events.title: Demo Patch Notes for 2026-09-13
events.summary: Fixed some lighting issues that could cause flickering during the transition from night to dayFixed some issues with skylight exposure; skies will now appear more blue/saturated during the dayImplemented a new procedural landscape grass type that should allow for denser grass without causing significant performance costsFixed/cleaned up some streamed level actors in a few placesThe game now defaults to 07:00 on new playthroughs so that new players should typically have full daylight by the time

events.title: Demo Patch Notes for 2026-08-28
events.summary: Significantly improved the look of curb splines with new custom curb meshesFixed an issue with the new ice and fire boss abilities

events.title: Demo Patch Notes for 2026-08-27
events.summary: The following changes will be rolled out slowly on Beta branches first, with general roll out for all players coming later:Added new boss magic abilities to the ancient fire mageAdded new boss magic abilities to the ice captainImproved loading when exiting the tutorial dungeon to prevent asset pop-in in this area

events.title: Demo Patch Notes for 2026-08-21
events.summary: Started work on a new quest / assets for upcoming September/October game festivalsCreated new 3D assets for streetlampsImproved the Parallax Occlusion Mapping on cobblestone and mud for the landscape; cobblestones now appears to proper depth

events.title: Demo Patch Notes for 2026-08-17b
events.summary: The following changes will be shipped to all demo install versions later this afternoon:Added new character creation parametersPlayers can now customize skin tone, hair darkness, hair redness, and eye color when making a new characterThe character creation camera now zooms in on the player character's portrait when editing hair/eyes, making the changes easier to seeFixed an issue with 1H animation blendspaces not playing footstep sounds sometimesFixed an issue with Mausoleum memory spawned cache

events.title: Demo Patch Notes for 2026-08-17
events.summary: The following changes will ship later this afternoon to all demo install versions:Added support for vaulting for NPCsHumanoid characters will now vault smoothly over outdoor retaining walls instead of jumping

events.title: Demo Patch Notes for 2026-08-16
events.summary: Finished work on updated catacomb meshesShipped an additional fix for potential 'Fatal Error' the first time the game is ever launched; there is still at least one potential cause for this issue being investigated, but for the moment simply launching the game a second time seems to always resolve the problemFixed a display issue with some catacomb material slots

events.title: Demo Patch Notes for 2026-08-11
events.summary: The donkey will now make more varied braying noises when calledFixed an issue with the bed in the Gravenstaad player house being sometimes unusable

events.title: Demo Patch Notes for 2026-08-10
events.summary: Books now have a more polished appearance, and will display text on the page more neatly as wellRe-created the book widget 2D UI elementsRe-wrote functions for pagination of book textAdded support for recommended graphics settings presetsGraphics settings preset buttons (in the graphics settings menu) will now auto-apply recommended settings for Low, Medium, High, and Ultra graphicsAdded several new small GPU performance optimizations

events.title: Demo Patch Notes for 2026-08-09
events.summary: Fixed another potential issue with keybind remapping that could cause re-binding an action to fail when attempting to re-bind it to a key that is already in use

events.title: Demo Patch Notes for 2026-08-08b
events.summary: Fixed a secondary issue with key rebinding that could potentially cause keys to fail to rebind correctlyKeybinds are now sorted by group/function rather than alphabeticallyAdded a cheat codes console to the gameplay settings menu, with codes to be added in a future updateFixed a potential fatal error that could occur on some systems when the game is launched for the first time after a fresh install
